reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited paragraphs support the preferred position: Section 12.3 gives AbbVie (our party) an at-will termination right on 90 days' notice with no early-termination, minimum, or liquidated amount; Section 12.9 merely preserves ordinary legal/equitable remedies rather than imposing a stipulated sum.

Section 6.10 late-payment interest applies reciprocally to 'either Party' and is compensatory interest, correctly characterized as not a Customer-payable penalty; accrued milestones/royalties are earned consideration, not liquidated damages.
Rationale is accurate and no actionable deviation exists, so no edit is warranted; retained as internal evidence only.
